dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: Guess what? This guy I know from the village has turned really lazy all of a sudden. He just lies there sleeping, all day long...

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: Tee-hee, do I do a good impression of Uncle Draff or what?

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: Uncle Draff says if you wanna be a hunter, the first step is being able to chase your prey. I can already catch up with the cats in the neighborhood!

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: But I'm still nowhere near as good as my dad. He runs so fast, he can catch anything!

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: He went to chase a huuuge boar. It'll be ages and ages before he gets back.

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: I wanted to go and help my dad with the hunt, but Uncle Draff said I'm not big enough yet, I wouldn't be strong enough to be a hunter, and it would only make things worse if I went.

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: So I wanna grow up as fast as I can, learn how to hunt, and then I'll be able to help dad!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's the spirit! Good luck, bye!

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: I'm gonna be a great hunter one day, I just know it!

dialogues.speaker: Pepe
dialogues.text: Then I can go help dad finally catch that boar!
